scope: Sequential integration regression only; no answer generation, inference matrix, downloads or corpus expansion
new_interactions: explicitly unload model before personal-library return search
real OCR and WAV recognition edited and returned to question without submission
load-only model failure recovery, no generated token
storage: Current logical and allocated app trees plus installed APK on each tested emulator, periodically sampled; model selector, retained objects, optional recognition assets and catalog hashes; samples are not continuous or physical-device peaks
identity: Every lane must build the identical application APK and retain raw behavioral receipts; changed/missing receipt and wrong APK identity must fail aggregate verification
limits: Gradle2 workers/2GiB heap, serial recognition; no protected inference process inspection or changes;5564 untouched
